performance_tasks.brief: A Paper 3 style investigation task (about 10 marks): an experiment described in words with our own readings in a table. The learner decides variables, controls and how to measure, draws up the results table (quantity and unit headings, consistent significant figures), plots or describes the graph, calculates a value with working, identifies sources of error and suggests an improvement. Readings are ours and are labelled as such.
performance_tasks.objective_ids: choose 2-4 objectives from this topic that the task genuinely exercises

performance_tasks.brief: A second Paper 3 style task (about 10 marks), different in setting from the first and fitted to this topic. Where the topic concerns microscopy, drawing or measuring specimens: a specimen or photomicrograph described in words with measurements given, asking what a plan diagram or cell drawing would show, a graticule calibration or actual-size or magnification calculation with working in micrometres, a comparison of two specimens by observable features only, and an improvement. Otherwise: a second, different investigation (a different experiment, data set or results table) testing the same skills as this topic's objectives. Values and readings are ours and are labelled as such.
performance_tasks.objective_ids: choose 2-4 objectives from this topic that the task genuinely exercises

ao_mix_note: The syllabus states its AO weights as a share of MARKS, so planned_ao_mix_by_marks is the one that answers "does this resource match the exam". It values each card at the tariff of the question it models, split across the AOs the card declares, and values each performance task at the marks of the paper part it models. The count-based mix below is reported only because it is what a reader expects to see; do not balance against it. AO shares by ITEM COUNT: Every objective needs one recall anchor, so AO1 has a structural floor of about 34% in this topic (12 objectives against 35 slots) and cannot reach the None% target by count however many other cards are added - padding the bank to chase it makes the resource worse. The framework already measures the AO4 share in practice time rather than by count for the same reason. Treat AO1 above target as expected, and AO2/AO3/AO4 below target as the thing worth fixing.
